page.overview:
Who is Mic?

Mic is a stoic man with an unique aesthetic sense, shaving himself in the bathroom to maintain his skin head. He is a bit overconfident, to the point of looking down on others. Lately he has been muscle training while listening to French hip-hop. There is a bad leakage problem in his apartment.

Mic is quick but has low health and deals only a small amount of damage.
